latvia.title: Kolaps NATO a rozklad EÚ zvnútra. Putin sa po Ukrajine zameral na strategickú prioritu číslo dva
latvia.description: Moldavsko má pre Kremeľ mimoriadny význam.

latvia.title: Francúzi zachytili nad Baltom ruské lietadlo FSB. Na palube malo nezvyčajný laserový systém
latvia.description: Francúzske stíhačky Rafale ukončili štvormesačné nasadenie v rámci misie NATO Baltic Air Policing. Letectvo pri zhrnutí misie zverejnilo aj fotografiu stíhačky Dassault Rafale pri zachytení ruského lietadla Tupolev Tu-214 nad Baltským morom.

latvia.title: O Oscara pro Česko bude usilovat osobní dokument o závislosti
latvia.description: Do klání o mezinárodního Oscara vyslala Česká filmová a televizní akademie (ČFTA) celovečerní dokument režisérky Pepy Lubojacki Kdyby se holubi proměnili ve zlato. Snímek natočený v koprodukci České televize měl premiéru na festivalu Berlinale, kde získal cenu za nejlepší dokumentární film a také vedlejší nezávislé ocenění Caligari. Do české kinodistribuce oficiálně vstoupí na konci září.

latvia.title: Ce semnal transmit investițiile străine directe, după o scădere de 82% în primul semestru. Explicațiile prim-viceguvernatorului BNR
latvia.description: Investițiile străine directe în România au scăzut cu aproximativ 82% în primul semestru din 2026, la 669 de milioane de euro, față de 3,72 miliarde de euro în aceeași perioadă din 2025. Declinul are legătură cu distribuirea dividendelor, reducerea profitabilității companiilor cu capital străin și o serie de factori conjuncturali, a explicat prim-viceguvernatorul BNR, Leonardo Badea. Acesta a avertizat că evoluția transmite „un semnal care nu poate fi ignorat”.

latvia.title: Noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, criticate de părinți: „Copiii se vor lupta cu arme inegale”
latvia.description: Părinții se tem că noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, care ar permite colegiilor să organizeze examene proprii pentru o parte dintre locuri, vor aduce un stres suplimentar pentru elevi și vor favoriza familiile care își permit meditații. Unii părinți vorbesc chiar despre riscul ca examenele să devină o „formalitate” și să apară „pile” la liceele dorite. Roxana Paraschiv, coordonator de program la Salvați Copiii, avertizează că introducerea unor probe suplimentare ar adânci diferențele dintre elevi și ar putea afecta sănătatea mintală a copiilor.

latvia.title: NATO dă asigurări că poate aborda „oricare amenințare”. Reacția vizează în special Teheranul
latvia.description: Alianţa Nord-Atlantică este pregătită să abordeze orice ameninţare şi va face întotdeauna tot ce este necesar pentru a-şi apăra aliaţii, a declarat miercuri un oficial al NATO, relatează Reuters. Afirmaţia a venit ca răspuns la întrebări despre un articol din Financial Times conform căruia Iranul ar lua în considerare atacarea de ţinte militare americane din Europa, în cazul în care preşedintele SUA, Donald Trump, ar escalada războiul.

latvia.title: Elveția își cheamă cetățenii la urne pentru a lua o decizie istorică privind neutralitatea
latvia.description: Se pare că alegătorii elvețieni vor respinge luna viitoare propunerile privind o definiție mai strictă a neutralității, care ar împiedica țara să impună sancțiuni economice sau să coopereze cu NATO, potrivit unui sondaj publicat miercuri, transmite reuters.

latvia.title: Melania „nu agreează” speculațiile privind relația lui Trump cu una dintre colaboratoarele sale. Cine este Nathalie Harp
latvia.description: Speculațiile privind relația lui Donald Trump cu una dintre cele mai apropiate colaboratoare ale sale o deranjează pe soția sa, Melania, potrivit unor rapoarte. Administrația Trump a ripostat după ce senatorul Jon Ossoff a glumit luni că președintele SUA ar fi distras de o aventură extraconjugală cu Natalie Harp, asistenta executivă a președintelui american în vârstă de 80 de ani.

latvia.title: Rușii donează miliarde pentru războiul lui Putin din Ucraina. Suma impresionantă strânsă în vistieria statului
latvia.description: Donatorii ruși au vărsat peste 383 de miliarde de ruble (4,5 miliarde de dolari) în vistieria statului în urma unui apel pentru contribuții voluntare, pe măsură ce costul războiului Moscovei împotriva Ucrainei continuă să crească, informează cotidianul de afaceri Vedomosti, citat de agenția DPA.

latvia.title: Cazul avionului chinez interceptat de avioane maghiare de luptă la granița cu România. Ancheta a dezvăluit cauza incidentului
latvia.description: Un avion al companiei Cathay Pacific, cu sediul în Hong Kong, a fost interceptat de două avioane de vânătoare maghiare ale NATO deasupra spațiului aerian românesc. Incidentul a avut loc pe 4 iulie. Acum, ancheta în acest caz arată că pilotul a selectat o frecvență radio greșită după ce a răspuns din greșeală la instrucțiunile controlului de trafic aerian destinate unei alte aeronave.

latvia.title: Estonian raw milk producer to buy Latvia's largest dairy plant
latvia.description: Estonia's largest raw milk producer has signed an agreement to acquire Latvia's largest dairy processing company, which, among other things, produces the popular Karūms brand.

latvia.title: Dissent within Latvian coalition over future airBaltic plan
latvia.description: The Greens and Farmers' Union (ZZS) does not agree with its coalition partners over the proposal to give the government the right to invest additional funds in the Latvian national airline airBaltic.

latvia.title: Renovation of Kuldīga Cultural Centre to resume after 3 year pause
latvia.description: Three years ago, the reconstruction of the Kuldīga Cultural Centre was halted by the insolvency of the construction contractor. In order to resume the work, changes were made to the project and new sources of financing were sought. It has now been decided that the renovation will take place in stages, also raising money gradually.

latvia.title: Estonian company to buy Latvia's biggest dairy processing business
latvia.description: Estonia's Falber Investments OÜ, the parent company of Agrone, Estonia’s largest agricultural group and the region’s largest independent raw milk producer, has signed an agreement to acquire the group of AS Rīgas piena kombināts (RPK), Latvia’s largest dairy processing company, creating a new Baltic dairy behemoth.

latvia.title: Canadian military band starts tour of Latvia
latvia.description: The Central Band of the Canadian Armed Forces is visiting Latvia from August 19th to September 3rd, participating in events dedicated to the 35th anniversary of the National Guard and giving a series of concerts.

latvia.title: Popular advocate of Livonian culture takes leading role
latvia.description: On August 19th, a meeting of the National Cultural Council was held at the Ministry of Culture (KM), where one of the issues was the election of the chairperson and deputy chairperson of the council itself.

latvia.title: Slight increase in hotel stays in second quarter of 2026 in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau data published on August 19, in Q2 2026 the number of non-resident and resident arrivals at Latvian tourist accommodation establishments comprised 750.0 thousand, which is an increase of 1.2 % compared with Q2 2025.

latvia.title: Affordable rental flats to be built in Rīga
latvia.description: By 2030, it is planned to build 732 affordable rental homes in Rīga – in the Pļavnieki, Ziepniekkalns, and Bolderāja disctricts, according to the agency State Real Estate (Valsts nekustamie īpašumi, VNĪ).

latvia.title: Latvian police say they have thwarted prison conspiracy
latvia.description: The State Police claimed on August 19 that they have foiled a plan organised from within prison to rob and severely beat a man, the police have reported.

latvia.title: 'Operation Werewolf' sniffs out more illegal border crossers
latvia.description: On Tuesday, August 18th, in Krāslava district, soldiers of the National Armed Forces detained someone who was transporting persons who had illegally crossed the state border, according to releases from the State Border Guard and the government.

latvia.title: New tree park to be planted in Latvia as part of World Cleanup Day
latvia.description: In one month's time a 10th Happiness Tree Park will be opened as part of the World Cleanup Day, which will take place in approximately 200 countries on September 20th, including Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian CSDD bosses step down
latvia.description: All board members of the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) have submitted a letter to the Minister for Transport, Rihards Kozlovskis (New Unity), Kozlovskis said on Wednesday, August 19.

latvia.title: Latvian and Lithuanian national militias stand shoulder to shoulder
latvia.description: Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the National Guard (Zemessardze), the National Guard has signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union (Lietuvos šaulių sąjunga) to strengthen cooperation and exchange of experience between the two organizations.

latvia.title: Latvian citizen to be prosecuted for war glorification
latvia.description: On 14 August this year, the State Security Service (VDD) urged the Public Prosecutor’s Office to initiate criminal proceedings against a Latvian citizen for the prolonged and systematic glorification and justification of the war waged by Russia in Ukraine, inciting hatred against Ukrainians, as well as the unauthorised possession of a high-powered air gun and explosives.

latvia.title: New rules will let Latvian army requisition private land in an emergency
latvia.description: On Tuesday, August 18th, the Cabinet of Ministers supported amendments to the National Security Law proposed by the Ministry of Defence, which provide for granting the National Armed Forces the temporary right to use land owned by private individuals, if it is deemed necessary for national defence.

latvia.title: CSDD boss ready to quit over massive database leak
latvia.description: The head of the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD), Aivars Aksenoks, is preparing to resign from his position after the investigation into the cyberattack that the CSDD experienced in early August is completed, Aksenoks announced in an interview with Latvian Television's "Morning Panorama" on August 19th.

latvia.title: 'Psychics' scam two women for over 150 thousand euros in Latvia
latvia.description: Two women, having fallen for advertisements posted on the social networking site ‘Facebook’ which purported to offer the services of psychics, transferred a total of more than 150,000 euros to the fraudsters, the State Police reported on August 18.

latvia.title: Some rain across most of Latvia Wednesday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that brief showers are expected in many parts of Latvia on Wednesday.

latvia.title: Ban on credit advertising lifted in Latvia
latvia.description: From Wednesday, 18 August, the ban on consumer credit advertising has been lifted, whilst strict requirements have been imposed on the content of such adverts, Latvian Radio reported on August 19.

latvia.title: Latvian government weakens protection for larger trees
latvia.description: The Latvian government decided on Tuesday, August 18, that larger trees will be allowed to be cut down outside forests than were previously allowed to be felled.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 18th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Ukrainians plan to sing Latvian national anthem in Rīga
latvia.description: At midday on August 22nd, at at the Freedom Monument in Rīga, the Latvian anthem will ring out, but this time it will not be sung by Latvians.

latvia.title: Data of 1.2 million people breached in recent CSDD cyberattack
latvia.description: The Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) reported on August 18 that personal data relating to 1.2 million people was obtained in a cyberattack. Latvia's total population is a little over 1.8 million, so as a proportion of the population, the breach is enormous.

latvia.title: Latvian State Police wants to put lawyer in the dock
latvia.description: The Latvian State Police has completed an investigation into the actions of sworn attorney Inese Šulte and another private individual, requesting that both be charged with attemtping to influence a suspect, the LETA newswire reports.

latvia.title: Special Saeima sitting will mark 35th restoration of 'de facto' independence
latvia.description: On August 21st – the day when Latvia's independence was de facto restored 35 years ago – the Saeima will gather for a special ceremonial sitting at 12:00.

latvia.title: Only in Latvia: new train named after particularly popular mushroom
latvia.description: The Latvian mania for funghi is well documented, and on August 18th gets another entry with news that a shiny new passenger train will be honoured with the name of a particularly popular species of edible mushroom.

latvia.title: Latvia spends less than EU average on education
latvia.description: New data published by Eurostat shows levels of public spending on education across the European Union – and reveals that Latvia spends less than the majority of its EU peers on this crucial investment in the future.

latvia.title: Latvia's Oscar nominee is 'Ulya'
latvia.description: Viesturs Kairišs' feature film Uļa (Ulya) has been named Latvia's candidate for the Academy Awards this year, according to representatives of the National Film Centre (NKC).

latvia.title: More sauce? Spilva expands its Babīte factory
latvia.description: Food manufacturer “Orkla Latvija” plans to invest 5.4 million euros in the modernisation of the “Spilva” sauce and ready-meal production facility in Babīte, the company said on August 18.

latvia.title: Four migrants caught in Ķekava municipality, Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday morning, August 18, the Ķekava Municipal Police detained four migrants on the Rīga bypass between the Daugmale roundabout and the Riga Hydroelectric Power Station and handed them over to the State Border Guard, the municipal police said.

latvia.title: Public invited to choose their Latvian building of the year
latvia.description: The organizers of the Best Building of the Year in Latvia 2025 competition – the Latvian Builders' Association and the Latvian Union of Civil Engineers – are inviting the public to vote for the buildings submitted for the competition and put into operation in 2025, which are of the most benefit to society.

latvia.title: Call to halt law on mandatory dubbing of films in Latvian
latvia.description: The Latvian Association of Broadcasters, Latvian Public Media (LSM) and the Latvian Film Producers’ Association call on the Saeima not to support the amendments to the Electronic Mass Media Law, which would require television content in languages other than the official languages of the European Union (EU) Member States to be dubbed in Latvian.

latvia.title: Vidzeme farmers happy with this year's grain harvest
latvia.description: Combine harvesters are active in the grain fields of Vidzeme right now as they seek to get their grain into storage during dry conditions. Farmers assess this year as successful in terms of harvest, despite increases in the price of mineral fertilizers and fuel, and some rains early in the season.

latvia.title: 'Buckle up' signal to sound throughout Latvia on Tuesday
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 18 August, at 11:00, a signal warning of a seatbelt not being fastened will be broadcast on radio stations and at petrol stations. This will mark the start of the Road Traffic Safety Directorate’s (CSDD) new campaign: “The last dance begins without a seatbelt. Don’t take chances – buckle up!”, CSDD said in a release.

latvia.title: Rinkēvičs: Latvia lacks border guards
latvia.description: Significant progress has been made in the construction of infrastructure along the Latvian–Belarusian border, but there are serious problems with human resources – this was the conclusion reached by President Edgars Rinkēvičs during a visit to Piedruja, a village on the border with Belarus, on August 18.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: airBaltic bondholders agree to capitalise interest payments
latvia.description: Bondholders of the national airline ‘airBaltic’ voted in favour of capitalising interest payments on the bonds at a meeting on Monday, 17 August, the airline announced.

latvia.title: State Security Service demands prosecution of Daugavpils separatist
latvia.description: On August 17th, the Latvian State Security Service (VDD) said that a week earlier it had asked the Prosecution Office to initiate criminal prosecution against a Latvian 'non-citizen' for expressing support towards ideas directed against the territorial integrity of Latvia.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs returns to Latvia's eastern border
latvia.description: On August 17th Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs made another one of his regular visits to the country's eastern border.

latvia.title: Diver lost in Baltic sea in July found
latvia.description: The body of a diver who went missing in mid-July has been found in the sea off Roja, the State Police (VP) reported on Monday, 17 August.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank's 'Financial Stability Report' available in English
latvia.description: The Latvian central bank, Latvijas Banka (LB) has published its annual Financial Stability Report in English. A report has been published every year since 2003 "to raise public awareness regarding the development of the Latvian financial system and to draw attention to systemic risks."

latvia.title: Finance Minister, central bank governor talk future EU funds
latvia.description: At the end of last week, Finance Minister Māris Kučinskis (United List) met with Bank of Latvia (LB) Governor Mārtiņš Kazāks to discuss possible cooperation between the Ministry of Finance (FM) and the LB in preparation for the next European Union (EU) funds planning period 2028-2034.

latvia.title: Company registration numbers down in Latvia, but so are bankruptcies
latvia.description: In the second quarter of 2026, registrations of businesses in the EU decreased by 0.5% compared with the first quarter of 2026, while bankruptcies increased by 5.7% according to data on business registrations and bankruptcies published by Eurostat today.

latvia.title: Latvians spent EUR 619 monthly on household needs last year
latvia.description: In 2025, mean monthly household consumption expenditure per household member amounted to 619 euros, according to Central Statistical Bureau data published on August 17.

latvia.title: Scammer e-mails 'from Swedbank' active again in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, August 17, Swedbank customers have again received targeted emails from scammers, Swedbank said in a statement.

latvia.title: Drone that was shot down in Latvia entered from Belarus
latvia.description: The drone shot down in the Balvi region on Friday flew into Latvian airspace from Belarus, Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview on Latvian Television on Monday morning.

latvia.title: 'Last chance' to save airBaltic, says Latvian Prime Minister
latvia.description: Latvian Television's 'De Facto' investigative show reported on August 16th on the current situation at Latvia's cash-strapped national airline, airBaltic.

latvia.title: All fairly quiet in Latvian border area since 'Operation Werewolf'
latvia.description: Since the start of Operation ‘Vilkatis’ (Werewolf), which aims to increase monitoring of the movement of illegal migrants and their smugglers along the country’s border, no one has been detained, Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with Latvian Radio and Latvian Television on Monday morning.

latvia.title: Weather will improve later in the week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected more frequently in Latvia during the first half of the week.

latvia.title: Political poster exhibition opens at Latvian National Library
latvia.description: With the Saeima elections fast approaching in October, an exhibition of political posters entitled “The Language of Power – Agitation, Propaganda, Art” opens on Monday, August 17, at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian State Forests blames miscommunication for recent cyber attack
latvia.description: Earlier this summer, the Latvian State Forests (LVM) IT systems suffered a cyber attack. It happened through a vulnerability that hadn't been updated in two years, although LVM had been notified of it, Latvian Television's De Facto reports on August 16.

lithuania.title: Francúzi zachytili nad Baltom ruské lietadlo FSB. Na palube malo nezvyčajný laserový systém
lithuania.description: Francúzske stíhačky Rafale ukončili štvormesačné nasadenie v rámci misie NATO Baltic Air Policing. Letectvo pri zhrnutí misie zverejnilo aj fotografiu stíhačky Dassault Rafale pri zachytení ruského lietadla Tupolev Tu-214 nad Baltským morom.

lithuania.title: O Oscara pro Česko bude usilovat osobní dokument o závislosti
lithuania.description: Do klání o mezinárodního Oscara vyslala Česká filmová a televizní akademie (ČFTA) celovečerní dokument režisérky Pepy Lubojacki Kdyby se holubi proměnili ve zlato. Snímek natočený v koprodukci České televize měl premiéru na festivalu Berlinale, kde získal cenu za nejlepší dokumentární film a také vedlejší nezávislé ocenění Caligari. Do české kinodistribuce oficiálně vstoupí na konci září.

lithuania.title: Ce semnal transmit investițiile străine directe, după o scădere de 82% în primul semestru. Explicațiile prim-viceguvernatorului BNR
lithuania.description: Investițiile străine directe în România au scăzut cu aproximativ 82% în primul semestru din 2026, la 669 de milioane de euro, față de 3,72 miliarde de euro în aceeași perioadă din 2025. Declinul are legătură cu distribuirea dividendelor, reducerea profitabilității companiilor cu capital străin și o serie de factori conjuncturali, a explicat prim-viceguvernatorul BNR, Leonardo Badea. Acesta a avertizat că evoluția transmite „un semnal care nu poate fi ignorat”.

lithuania.title: Noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, criticate de părinți: „Copiii se vor lupta cu arme inegale”
lithuania.description: Părinții se tem că noile reguli pentru admiterea la liceu, care ar permite colegiilor să organizeze examene proprii pentru o parte dintre locuri, vor aduce un stres suplimentar pentru elevi și vor favoriza familiile care își permit meditații. Unii părinți vorbesc chiar despre riscul ca examenele să devină o „formalitate” și să apară „pile” la liceele dorite. Roxana Paraschiv, coordonator de program la Salvați Copiii, avertizează că introducerea unor probe suplimentare ar adânci diferențele dintre elevi și ar putea afecta sănătatea mintală a copiilor.

lithuania.title: NATO dă asigurări că poate aborda „oricare amenințare”. Reacția vizează în special Teheranul
lithuania.description: Alianţa Nord-Atlantică este pregătită să abordeze orice ameninţare şi va face întotdeauna tot ce este necesar pentru a-şi apăra aliaţii, a declarat miercuri un oficial al NATO, relatează Reuters. Afirmaţia a venit ca răspuns la întrebări despre un articol din Financial Times conform căruia Iranul ar lua în considerare atacarea de ţinte militare americane din Europa, în cazul în care preşedintele SUA, Donald Trump, ar escalada războiul.

lithuania.title: Elveția își cheamă cetățenii la urne pentru a lua o decizie istorică privind neutralitatea
lithuania.description: Se pare că alegătorii elvețieni vor respinge luna viitoare propunerile privind o definiție mai strictă a neutralității, care ar împiedica țara să impună sancțiuni economice sau să coopereze cu NATO, potrivit unui sondaj publicat miercuri, transmite reuters.

lithuania.title: Melania „nu agreează” speculațiile privind relația lui Trump cu una dintre colaboratoarele sale. Cine este Nathalie Harp
lithuania.description: Speculațiile privind relația lui Donald Trump cu una dintre cele mai apropiate colaboratoare ale sale o deranjează pe soția sa, Melania, potrivit unor rapoarte. Administrația Trump a ripostat după ce senatorul Jon Ossoff a glumit luni că președintele SUA ar fi distras de o aventură extraconjugală cu Natalie Harp, asistenta executivă a președintelui american în vârstă de 80 de ani.

lithuania.title: Rușii donează miliarde pentru războiul lui Putin din Ucraina. Suma impresionantă strânsă în vistieria statului
lithuania.description: Donatorii ruși au vărsat peste 383 de miliarde de ruble (4,5 miliarde de dolari) în vistieria statului în urma unui apel pentru contribuții voluntare, pe măsură ce costul războiului Moscovei împotriva Ucrainei continuă să crească, informează cotidianul de afaceri Vedomosti, citat de agenția DPA.

lithuania.title: Cazul avionului chinez interceptat de avioane maghiare de luptă la granița cu România. Ancheta a dezvăluit cauza incidentului
lithuania.description: Un avion al companiei Cathay Pacific, cu sediul în Hong Kong, a fost interceptat de două avioane de vânătoare maghiare ale NATO deasupra spațiului aerian românesc. Incidentul a avut loc pe 4 iulie. Acum, ancheta în acest caz arată că pilotul a selectat o frecvență radio greșită după ce a răspuns din greșeală la instrucțiunile controlului de trafic aerian destinate unei alte aeronave.

lithuania.title: Latvian and Lithuanian national militias stand shoulder to shoulder
lithuania.description: Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the National Guard (Zemessardze), the National Guard has signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union (Lietuvos šaulių sąjunga) to strengthen cooperation and exchange of experience between the two organizations.

lithuania.title: Estija: ginklų gamybos įmonės pastato padegimas buvo tyčinis, Latvijoje sulaikyti trys įtariamieji
lithuania.description: Tiriant ankstyvą šeštadienio rytą Taline įvykdytą gynybos sprendimų bendrovės „Milrem Robotics“ naudojamo pastato padegimą, Latvijoje sulaikyti trys įtariamieji, pranešė estų dienraštis „Postimees“.

lithuania.title: Fedorovas metė iššūkį Zelenskiui: tai – smūgis į silpniausias prezidento vietas
lithuania.description: Atleisto populiaraus ministro Mychailos Fedorovo raginimas surengti prezidento rinkimus Ukrainoje karo metu, smūgiuoja tiesiai į silpniausias Volodymyro Zelenskio vietas: mažėjantį populiarumą, nuolatinį pozicijos pasikeitimą personalo klausimais ir įsitraukimą į korupcijos skandalus. Apie tai naujausioje analizėje rašo CNN.

lithuania.title: Rusijoje jau sklando gandai: analitikai įvardijo tris galimus Gerasimovo įpėdinius
lithuania.description: Rusijos generalinio štabo vadas Valerijus Gerasimovas, kuriam šiemet sukaks 71-eri, yra neįprastai senyvo amžiaus tokioms pareigoms užimti. Šalyje jau sklando gandai, kad jis gali būti nušalintas nuo pareigų per artimiausius vienerius ar dvejus metus, nurodoma su Pentagonu bendradarbiaujančio CNA analitinio centro ataskaitoje.

lithuania.title: Rusų propagandininkai Estijoje aptiko ukrainiečių droną: tokių pranešimų nebuvo
lithuania.description: Rugpjūčio pradžioje socialiniuose tinkluose pradėjo plisti pranešimai apie esą Emario aviacijos bazėje Estijoje įvykusį incidentą, per kurį Ukrainos drono nuolaužos apgadino du Portugalijos naikintuvus F-16. Istoriją lydėjo tariama „The Defense Post“ publikacija ir vaizdo įrašas, turėję sustiprinti jos patikimumą. Tačiau faktų patikra parodė, kad pranešimas buvo suklastotas: Portugalijos naikintuvų tuo metu bazėje jau nebuvo, publikacija paskelbta tikrąjį leidinį imitavusioje svetainėje, o dalis vaizdinės medžiagos buvo sugeneruota dirbtiniu intelektu.

lithuania.title: JT žmogaus teisių vadovas: naujos JAV sankcijos TBT yra nepriimtinos

lithuania.title: URM: atlikus apklausą, buvo imtasi priemonių darbo atmosferai Lietuvos ambasadoje JAV gerinti

lithuania.title: Aidas Jurkštas: „Klaipėdos švyturys virsta biorokratų įkaitu“
lithuania.description: Šią savaitę Lietuvoje minint Pasaulinį švyturių savaitgalį, žinomas farologas ir VšĮ „Aido švyturiai“ vadovas Aidas Jurkštas metė rimtus kaltinimus uosto įmonėms bei Susisiekimo ministerijai. Paviešinta chronologija atskleidžia šokiruojantį vaizdą: valstybės lėšos švaistomos pažadams, istorinis paveldas tyliai išdraskomas, o viešoje miesto gatvėje fotografuoti bandantys užsienio svečiai traktuojami kaip nusikaltėliai.

lithuania.title: Donaldas Trumpas žada šiemet susitikti su Šiaurės Korėjos lyderiu
lithuania.description: JAV prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas (Donaldas Trampas) trečiadienį pareiškė, kad šiemet susitiks su Šiaurės Korėjos lyderiu Kim Jong Unu (Kim Čen Unu).

lithuania.title: Donaldas Trumpas teigia, kad Šiaurės Korėja turi 57 branduolinius ginklus

lithuania.title: Kenijoje sudužus turistiniam sraigtasparniui žuvo septyni žmonės
lithuania.description: Kenijoje trečiadienį sudužus sraigtasparniui, kuriuo skrido šeši turistai, žuvo visi septyni orlaivyje buvę žmonės, naujienų agentūrai AFP pranešė vietos pareigūnai.

lithuania.title: Rusai bėga, kol gali: šios valstybės sieną per parą kerta po 20 tūkst. žmonių
lithuania.description: Dešimtys tūkstančių Rusijos piliečių nusprendė išvykti į kaimyninį Sakartvelą, vis intensyviau sklandant gandams apie galimą mobilizacijos bangą šį rudenį, rašo naujienų portalas „The Moscow Times“.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis atleido padėjėją, galimai figūruojančią korupcijos byloje
lithuania.description: Praėjus vos dienai po to, kai nušalintas Ukrainos gynybos ministras netikėtai paskelbė raginimą karo metu surengti rinkimus, prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis trečiadienį atleido vieną iš aukščiausio rango padėjėjų, kuri, kaip pranešama, figūruoja korupcijos tyrime.

lithuania.title: Vienoje Kauno vietoje – avarija po avarijos

lithuania.description: Utenos rajone trečiadienio pavakarę ratus suko du NATO naikintuvai. Lietuvos kariuomenė 15min atsakė, kokiu tikslu šie orlaiviai ten skrido.

lithuania.title: Siaubingi vaizdai CAR: ieškodami aukso žuvo mažiausiai 100 žmonių
lithuania.description: Centrinės Afrikos Respublikoje (CAR) per nuošliaužą neteisėtoje aukso kasykloje pasienyje su Kamerūnu žuvo mažiausiai 100 žmonių, naujienų agentūrai AFP trečiadienį pranešė vietos šaltiniai.
